main.description: Create the named cluster and leave it RUNNING, in one call. This is the same create-on-read path getKubeconfig walks - the account workspace, its home, the Cluster record and the mounted child - followed by the same desired-state flip controlPlaneUp performs, so a door that wants a cluster it can immediately reach does not have to read a kubeconfig it will throw away and then wake the control plane in a second round trip. Idempotent in both halves: a second call finds the tree it made and patches a desired state that is already true. Requires a service-auth JWT from the CALLER's own PDS; the account is the VERIFIED token's iss and never read from this input. The response is the phase as of this call, so a caller that sees Initializing knows the tree exists and the control plane is still coming up, and can poll controlPlaneUp - which is where the 429 and its Retry-After live, because that is the verb a client-go driven caller retries on.

name.description: The cluster label, unique within the calling account. RFC-1123 label, <=63 characters.

phase.description: The cluster's phase as of this call, after the desired state was set to running. Initializing means the control plane is still coming up; the cluster exists either way.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Name absent, or not a legal RFC-1123 label within 63 characters.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: Missing or invalid service-auth token. Also returned when the token's aud is not this service or its lxm is not this method.

errors.name: IdentityRevoked
errors.description: The caller's identity carries a deny record for this account. The deny is written before any deletion, so it refuses while the revocation is still propagating - and it refuses BEFORE anything is created, which is what keeps create-on-read from re-arming a revoked account.

errors.name: ClusterNotFound
errors.description: The tree was created and the Cluster was not readable immediately after. Deliberately indistinguishable from a name that belongs to another account.

errors.name: ClusterDraining
errors.description: The cluster is being torn down and its desired state is frozen. Not retryable: a Draining cluster cannot be un-drained, by design - a cancellable teardown gate is a gate an operator clears to make the symptom go away.

errors.name: ClusterInitializing
errors.description: The cluster is still coming up. RETRYABLE: carries Retry-After, and client-go retries on it without further instruction.
